$comment: One entry per file in art/raw/, filled in from what the author reports: generator name and version exactly as the generator UI shows them, the date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the prompt id from art/GENERATOR_PROMPTS.md. metadataApproved: true once the author has seen the file's embedded metadata (npm run metadata) and approved committing it; a test refuses a committed raw without it. Optional note, e.g. that an edit was run in a new chat. Example: "01-master.png": { "generator": "...", "version": "...", "date": "2026-10-08", "prompt": "G1", "metadataApproved": true }
